test_data.body:
The CoreAPI surface

The CoreAPI is the single Go interface that exposes all CMS capabilities to plugins, scripts, and the MCP server. It has ~35 methods across 15 domains. Three adapters wrap it: the Tengo modules, the gRPC SquillaHost service, and the internal Go interface used by core handlers.

Domains

  • Nodes — CRUD + query
  • NodeTypes — register / get / list / update / delete
  • Taxonomies — register / list
  • Terms — list / create / update / delete
  • Settings — get / set / get-all
  • Events — emit / subscribe
  • Email — send (via event bus → provider plugin)
  • Menus — CRUD
  • Routes — register / remove
  • Filters — register / apply
  • Media — upload / get / query / delete
  • Users — get / query (read-only)
  • HTTP — outbound fetch
  • Log — leveled logging with caller prefix
  • DataStore — DataGet / DataQuery / DataCreate / DataUpdate / DataDelete / DataExec (raw SQL)
  • FileStorage — StoreFile / DeleteFile

Capability guard
